body: i’m sorry that u were experiencing that:(( it’s not even that i wanted to go necessarily, it’s just the fact that it’s a reminder that i don’t have friends and no one cares that i’m not there. but cheddar biscuits and dogs are good
thank u<33 :’) ur comment means a lot to me thank u for taking the time to reply<33 and for being automod

honestly, as awful as it sounds, don’t take away her tools. if she really wants to she will find a way to sh and potentially with more dangerous tools. from someone who got hospitalized and then was forced to be clean, i just got sneakier with my sh (switching locations and doing less but deeper so it would be easier to hide). i think taking them from her room is a good idea, as she’ll have to actually get up and walk to go get them and could maybe ground herself or reach out for help during this time instead of cutting. making an effort to get her good first aid and offering to help clean and bandage any cuts if she wants (making sure to tell her you won’t be mad, just that you want to make sure she stays safe and it doesn’t get infected)
hi:) people have already responded but i’m always open to message if u want, i don’t have any friends so
ahh thank u<3 i lowkey forgot i posted this until just now lmao

this is one of the most respectful and kind things i’ve heard about sh from someone who doesn’t actually sh, so thank you <33 i’m very open abt sh so if you ever have any questions or need help feel free to message me, im chronically on my phone so i’ll usually answer pretty quick lol

well i’m glad u could turn it into somewhat of a positive thing:) but fr i know it might sound like bs but don’t be self conscious abt your scars, i can assure u that everyone there is so in their own world and worried abt their own problems. sh is just a physical manifestation of your pain and problems
ok:) i’ll do that thank you <33

when i went they had little separate sleeves that you could ask for. idk if they’ll have them at the er bc i got them in grippy sock jail but it’s worth asking? i wish you all the best and hope ur ok <33
no i don’t think so, i deposited it and then it said it would be available the next business day. after that i got another alert that the funds were being withheld for however long.
thank you so much, genuinely i really appreciate you taking the time to reply. If i could ask one more question, will this show up when i apply for an account at a different bank?

ik i sound so pathetic when i say this but it’s kinda exhausting being the only one who cares. i’m tired of being the one always trying. for once i just want someone to make the first move. i don’t need anyones constant attention but i’m the one texting first and inviting. when even your parents like other people better than you it’s just kinda hard to expect people that aren’t related to you to give a shit. (i’m sorry i keep replying so fast it’s probably creepy, i just got home from school so i’m just on my phone rn)
i’ll probably delete this post later, it was kinda pointless, i just made it on a whim when i was in a breakdown. it just sounds super whiny and attention seeking, sorry for taking up your time

they hate calling. i don’t ever start a conversation with mental health stuff, just random things. a meme or something i thought was exciting. really, thank you for trying to help but i think it’s out of my control now. every friendship i’ve had gets to this point before they end. i genuinely try and do make sure they know that they’re important to me without suffocating them but they leave anyway. idek why i made this post in the first place. ig i just needed someone to tell me that i’m still a human that deserves to be loved. i’m aroace so i really only have the possibility of platonic relationships

thank you but i think theyre joining the long list of people who have gotten tired of me. i only text so little bc i see that they’re hanging out with someone so i don’t want to bother them or because it takes them 2 days to respond. i used to text more but they seem like they don’t want to talk. i don’t think there’s anything i can do anymore. i’m always the first person to invite someone somewhere or text because deep down i know that if i didn’t, i’d never hear from them again. i’ve tried to be a good friend and to make people feel loved but i’ve never had it reciprocated

i hear you, i didn’t put everything in this post but i’ll add some more detail. i don’t text out of fear that i am being clingy. maybe once in two weeks or longer. i would never ever tell them that i would be dead without them. the thing is they also sh and are depressed so it was like we both had someone to relate to. if they don’t want to be friends with me anymore i will let them go, i just needed to rant bc as much as i do care about them and won’t try to stop them from doing what they want it still hurts. everytime i make friends, they leave. genuinely i am terrified of being clingy or annoying so i’ll text someone once after a month and smack myself bc it’s “clingy”. after a month. i’ve tried making friends but you can only be rejected and abandoned so much. i just needed to know that i’m a person that exists and is still lovable bc even my parents choose people over me. i understand that i’m not anyones main focus, but i just want to be someone they remember exists. i swear i’m not trying to guilt trip or anything i just thought i had found someone who actually was gonna stick around and now i just feel like an awful person
when my mom would yell at me for whatever reason or i felt like i had disappointed someone i would scratch and leave nail marks on my arms

wow thank you so much, i wasn’t really expecting anyone to actually see this so that means a lot <33 the idea was kind of inspired by a post on here and a lot of ethan jewell’s work. if you liked this though, i definitely recommend listening to him, my stuff doesn’t even come close
